description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers waived/injured TE Tanner McLachlan.
items.impact: McLachlan will figure to seek another opportunity in training camp.
items.title: Tanner McLachlan waived by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers waived DB Derrick Canteen.
items.impact: Canteen will figure to seek another opportunity in training camp.
items.title: Derrick Canteen waived by 49ers

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Josiah Deguara signed a 1-year deal with the San Francisco 49ers on Friday.
items.impact: Deguara is the latest receiving option the 49ers have brought in after Ricky Pearsall's injury was discovered to be worse than originally expected. Deguara is entering his seventh year in the NFL and will likely serve as a depth piece in the San Francisco tight end room.
items.title: Josiah Deguara signs 1-year contract with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Deshaun Watson is taking the first-team reps at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Shedeur Sanders received the first-team reps at practice on Thursday. The two of them will continue to rotate who receives first-team reps.
items.title: Deshaun Watson takes first-team reps Friday

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Trenton Irwin has signed a 1-year contract with the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Irwin was brought in the day after San Francisco signed Deebo Samuel, another addition to the receiving corps following news that Ricky Pearsall could miss the upcoming season with a knee injury. Irwin appeared in just seven games with the Bengals last season and will likely be a depth piece for San Francisco this year.
items.title: Trenton Irwin signs 1-year deal with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. took 7-on-7 reps at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Penix is continuing to wait to be fully cleared to practice. It isn't expected to happen until late August.
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. takes 7-on-7 reps Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jack Strand took all of the 11-on-11 reps at Falcons training camp on Friday.
items.impact: Strand continues to work with the starters as Michael Penix Jr. and Tua Tagovailoa ease their way back from injuries. Penix took reps in 7-on-7 drills on Friday.
items.title: Jack Strand takes all 11-on-11 reps at Falcons practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyle Monangai was not seen at practice at Bears training camp on Friday.
items.impact: It is currently unclear why Monangai was not practicing. Salvon Ahmed was seeing more reps in his place.
items.title: Kyle Monangai not seen at practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens restructured DL Broderick Washington's contract.
items.impact: The Ravens and Washington agreed to a fully guaranteed, one-year, $2 million contract, opening up $2 million in cap space for the Ravens this season. He is working his way back from a torn Achilles.
items.title: Broderick Washington Jr. restructures contract with Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tua Tagovailoa participated in Friday's walkthrough at training camp.
items.impact: Tagovailoa has practiced back-to-back days after reportedly dealing with a back injury. He is continuing to trend in the right direction.
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa (back) participates in walkthrough Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Alim McNeill left Friday's practice early with an apparent neck injury.
items.impact: McNeill will be further evaluated. There should be an update on his status provided when absence.
items.title: Alim McNeill leaves practice early with apparent neck injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jimmy Rolder left Friday's practice early with an apparent leg injury.
items.impact: Rolder will be further evaluated. There should be an update on his status provided when absence.
items.title: Jimmy Rolder (leg) leaving practice early Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tank Dell participated in Friday's walkthrough at practice.
items.impact: It is another step in the right direction as he continues to be eased back into training camp. His status will need to continue to be monitored.
items.title: Tank Dell participates in walkthrough Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chris Olave took part in team drills at practice on Friday at Saints training camp.
items.impact: Olave was limited to individual drills earlier in the week. With his extension now out of the way, he'll now fully participate in practices.
items.title: Chris Olave takes part in team drills Friday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Zachariah Branch got some high praise from HC Kevin Stefanski, who said the rookie wideout is "wired the right way" and "somebody that really puts in the effort on a day-to-day basis."
items.impact: Branch has made some highlight plays already in training camp, and with the No.2 receiver spot wide open, he'll have every opportunity to impress and claim it. How he will be used in a Stefanski style offense will be interesting, as it doesn't traditionally cater to Branch's style of play, but that could change.
items.title: Zachariah Branch 'wired the right way' per HC Stefanski

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: DeForest Buckner is seeing 11-on-11 work in practice after doing individual work Wednesday and Thursday.
items.impact: This is a big step in the right direction for Buckner, who was only cleared to practice just days ago after undergoing surgery in the offseason. The expectation was for the Colts to take it easy on him, and they still may, but it certainly appears Buckner is getting back in rhythm.
items.title: DeForest Buckner seeing 11-on-11 work in practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Germie Bernard was taking reps with the first-team offense at Steelers training camp on Friday.
items.impact: Farbaugh notes that Bernard flexed into the backfield and then back out into the slot on a rep. He'll have a chance to compete for immediate snaps in the slot for Pittsburgh.
items.title: Germie Bernard sees reps with first-team offense Friday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Tucker Kraft has been activated off of the PUP list on Friday. He won't participate in team activities but will participate in individual drills and walkthroughs.
items.impact: This is great news for the up and coming tight end, who is hopeful for Week 1, which is becoming more of a possibility. Fantasy managers will need to monitor his progress, however, as there is a lot to be decided before the start of the season.
items.title: Tucker Kraft activated off of PUP list

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Anthony Firkser has signed with the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Firkser has spent time with the Lions in the past, notably 2023 and 2025, before signing with the Commanders this offseason before being released. Should the veteran be retained by the team, he will likely be a blocker and have little fantasy value.
items.title: Anthony Firkser signed by the Detroit Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Andrew Farmer II cleared waivers and reverted back to the 49ers roster.
items.impact: Farmer will be on injured reserve.
items.title: Andrew Farmer II clears waivers, reverts back to 49ers roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: William Bradley-King cleared waivers and reverted back to the 49ers roster.
items.impact: Bradley-King will be on injured reserve.
items.title: William Bradley-King clears waivers, reverts back to 49ers roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Jager Burton did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Burton felt a muscle pull while doing drills. Green Bay will be cautious with him early in training camp.
items.title: Jager Burton misses practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Keisean Nixon did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Nixon felt a muscle pull while doing drills. Green Bay will be cautious with him early in training camp.
items.title: Keisean Nixon does not practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Andy Dalton took second-team reps with the Eagles on Thursday.
items.impact: Dalton will continue to rotate second-team reps with Tanner McKee throughout training camp as they compete for the backup job.
items.title: Andy Dalton sees second-team reps Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jaguars expect Jack Kiser to return some time during training camp.
items.impact: Kiser will miss an unknown amount of time due to a knee injury.
items.title: Jack Kiser (knee) expected back during training camp

title: Fantasy Player News
